---level2 script---

local isPlayingDemo = false
local countFail = 0
local isSkip = true
local hasViewedStory = global.getBool("lvl2_b1")

if not hasViewedStory or not game.isRestart() then
	repeat
		if hasViewedStory then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		game.setUserInputEnabled(false)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(false)
		script.delay(1)
		sound.play("42-2")
		if dialog.show("Level2-1", faceWeixiao) ==1 then break end
		role.lookLeftRight()
		script.delay(3)
		sound.play("50-1")
		if dialog.show("Level2-2", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
		sound.play("60-1")
		if dialog.show("Level2-3", faceQidao) ==1 then break end
		if dialog.show("Level2-4", faceRenzhen) ==1 then break end
		game.showTutorialDiagram(2)
		if dialog.showMinTime("Level2-5", faceWeixiao,6.5) ==1 then break end
		game.showTutorialDiagram(0)

		game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
		
		--set story viewed flag
        global.setBool("lvl2_b1")

		game.restartTiming()
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
		
		isSkip = false
		
	until true
end

if isSkip then
	camera.gotoRole()
	camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)
	dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
	game.resumeLogic()
	game.showTutorialDiagram(0)
	game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
	role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
	game.restartTiming()
end

onRoleDied = function()
    countFail = countFail + 1
    game.setUserInputEnabled(false)
    if countFail <= 1 then
		sound.play("51-2")
        dialog.show("Level1-12", faceBujie)
    else
		sound.play("58-1")
        dialog.show("Level1-13", faceShengqi)
    end
    game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
    role.loadState()
end
